change_summary: Replaced hardcoded 1D grid `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 8),)` in kernel_function with a 2D lambda grid `lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']), triton.cdiv(ynumel, meta['YBLOCK']))` so autotune-selected XBLOCK/YBLOCK values are used and all 1,016,064 Y-elements are covered instead of just 128.
